They apply the next time the game starts
The logos and the three opening movies are skipped: START is pressed for you until the title. The language choice still waits for you.
While this is on, every character and link is open in Free Battle.

If you save in the game while this is on, the unlocks are written to the memory card and stay even after you turn it off; the app cannot undo that. Export your save first (Settings, Memory card) if you want to keep your current progress.
Both options are read when the game starts: change them before pressing Play.\n\nPCSX2 cheats (.pnach) do not apply: Hidden Leaf runs the game\'s code recompiled, not in an emulator.

In the game\'s top right corner. Time: each picture\'s time and the worst one. Full: also the time of the EE, VU1, GS and IOP.
Screen

How the game is shown. Portrait keeps the 4:3 picture across the screen\'s width; Automatic follows how the device is held and respects Android\'s rotation lock. Some handhelds keep their screen in landscape whatever is chosen.
Vulkan is the default and the one tested on every device. OpenGL ES is for GPUs whose Vulkan driver fails; if the game does not open with it, go back to Vulkan.
